modules.module_title: Carry out dyeing process for Ikkat weaving

pcs.pc_description: Create/collect design on the graph paper as per imagination/market trend Products: Saree, blankets, mats, carpets, bed sheets, pillow covers, furnishing cloths, etc.
develop single or multi-colour dyeing pattern as per the design
select material from various types of fabric as per requirement Types: Cotton, silk, etc.
prepare the required number of warp/weft yarn bunch based on design requirement
spread the warp yarn with lease horizontally by fixing both the ends on wall, with required height form the ground level with intermediate support under the yarn bunch to avoid slackness
set distance between the wooden block for weft yarn spreading
spread the weft yarn with lease between the wooden board
mark the design using Sketch/Pen over the warp/ weft yarn bunch based on design repeat
mark for reference lines on both sides of yarn bunch in case of weft yarn
select and tie the warp/weft threads with rubber as per the markings made on yarn bunch
carry out pre-dyeing operation of the silk/cotton yarns using appropriate materials
identify different types of dyes depending upon the types of yarns Types: Silk, natural, reactive, etc.
dye the warp/weft threads using tie & dye technique to create the desired pattern
carry out the dyeing process in sequence based on number of colors need to be dyed for warp/ weft yarns
interchange and tie the previously dyed portion for next colour dyeing
make sure that yarn should not be allowed for complete drying till completion of dyeing of all the remaining colours
wash the threads after dyeing and allow it for dry in open air
bundle and treat the threads with suitable chemicals for color fastness if needed
re-wound the warp yarn in sectional warping drum to produce weavers beam
re-wound the weft yarn in wrap reel and convert it into hank form to produce pirn
segregate the weft yarn based on order/colour as per design to be woven
